title: The Final Podcast: 7 Lessons for the House You Build
summary: Fulfilling a private charge given by Elder Neil L. Anderson to 'teach missionaries how to succeed in life,' President Hughes delivers his final podcast on the day of his release. He wraps up his three-year tenure in the Philippines Quezon City North Mission by offering seven timeless parables and lessons: the three-feet-from-gold mine (perseverance), the jar of rocks and sand (prioritization), the king's boulder in the road (obstacle as opportunity), the boy diving for air (self-motivation), a joke told three times (the futility of complaining), the name-tagged balloons (finding happiness through service), and the retiring carpenter who cut corners on his own house (building a high-quality life). He concludes with personal logistics regarding his transition and departure.
